exports.note: History as numbers, continued by passes on causes, Events and places, and corrections from blind readers; then, on 2026-10-14 and 15, passes that placed every Event, filled the Americas, Oceania and South-eastern Asia, carved the tree of processes with recorded carves (28 carves, 113 processes), and checked and corrected that work; a further pass on 0.13.1 carved 14 more and recorded 19 processes kept whole, each with its reason (152 processes). 1,143 Events, 188 weighed causes, 3,309 importance judgments; the coverage report says this pass is done. The graph history was rebuilt on 2026-10-14, so graph hashes from revision 1 on differ from copies made before that date.
